description.narrative: Cash Learning Partnership (CaLP) has four strategic objectives, all closely linked to its Global Framework for Action, as follows; capacity building, knowledge management and research, co -ordination and policy. This project will consist of activities which build further on the progress already being made across each of these objectives, enabling the collective progress needed to deliver on major commitments such as the Grand Bargain, and repositioning CaLP in its ongoing engagement with its members and through headline events such as the Global Cash Forum and the State of the World's Cash report.
